headline: Zero deployed contract addresses discovered; website and GitHub unreachable.

findings.text: Block explorer name-tag search for 'DigiFT' did not return specific contract addresses; Etherscan explorer accessible but DigiFT-specific results not surfaced in search queries.
Official deployments doc not located; website fetch failed (https://www.digift.io/ returned network error).
No audit links provided in pinned inputs (audit_links: empty).
No GitHub repo provided in pinned inputs (github: none recorded).

Protocol operates on multiple chains (Ethereum, Binance, Arbitrum, Plume Mainnet per pinned inputs; additional chains Solana and Polygon mentioned in search results). No chain-specific address enumeration performed due to lack of base addresses.
Factory pattern discovery skipped—no factory addresses identified.
Role taxonomy not yet applied—no addresses catalogued.
No addresses recorded in admin_addresses[] due to discovery gaps.

rationale.verdict: Protocol appears operational and regulated (licensed by MAS and SFC per search results), but no deployed contract addresses were discovered despite searches and attempted website access. Core discovery sources (protocol website, GitHub, audits) remain inaccessible or unprovided.

evidence.shows: Protocol website; fetch failed with network error.
DigiFT announced tokenized index fund initiative mentioning smart contract-driven management and on-chain fund operations, confirming protocol operates smart contracts for fund management.
DappRadar lists DigiFT as RWA exchange supporting Ethereum, Arbitrum, Solana, and Polygon (contrary to pinned chain list which includes Plume but not Solana/Polygon).
Confirms DigiFT is a regulated exchange for on-chain RWAs with security token issuance and AMM trading.

protocol_metadata.about: <cite index="11-1">DigiFT, established in 2021, is the first regulated DeFi exchange for on-chain real-world assets, approved as a Recognised Market Operator with a Capital Markets Services license by the Monetary Authority of Singapore.</cite> <cite index="11-2,11-3">The platform provides financial services for primary market origination and distribution, as well as secondary market trading of asset-backed tokens backed by digital assets and real-world assets like bonds, equities, and units in collective investment schemes.</cite>
